description_en: Creates an egress proxy gateway instance
description_zh: 创建出口代理网关实例
name: CreateEgressProxyGateway

parameters.help_en:
The name of the egress proxy gateway instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
出口代理网关实例的名称。

长度为 2~128 个字符，必须以英文字母或中文开头，可包含中文、英文字母、数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: egress_proxy_gateway_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the egress proxy gateway instance.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, commas (,), periods (.), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
出口代理网关实例的描述信息。

长度为 2~256 个字符，可包含中文、英文字母、数字、半角逗号（,）、半角句号（.）、半角分号（;）、正斜线（/）、at（@）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the egress proxy gateway instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 出口代理网关实例所属专有网络 VPC 的 ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch that corresponds to the zone.

The vSwitch must belong to the specified VPC and match the zone specified by ZoneId
fields.help_zh:
可用区对应的交换机 ID。

该交换机必须属于本次指定的专有网络 VPC，且与所属可用区 ZoneId 匹配
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en:
The zone ID.

You can call the DescribeZones operation to query information about zones in a region
fields.help_zh:
可用区 ID。

您可以通过调用 DescribeZones 接口获取地域下可用区的相关信息
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The zone and vSwitch mappings of the egress proxy gateway instance.

If the current region supports two or more zones, add at least two zones to improve availability
parameters.help_zh:
出口代理网关实例的可用区及交换机映射列表。

若当前地域支持 2 个及以上的可用区，至少添加 2 个可用区以提升可用性
parameters.name: zone_mappings

parameters.help_en: The ID of the egress proxy configuration that is associated with the egress proxy gateway instance
parameters.help_zh: 出口代理网关实例关联的出口代理配置的 ID
parameters.name: egress_proxy_configuration_id

fields.help_en:
The listener port.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
fields.help_zh:
监听端口号。

取值范围：1~65535
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The protocol type of the listener. Valid values:

HTTP: HTTP.

HTTPS: HTTPS
fields.help_zh:
监听的协议类型。取值：

HTTP：HTTP 协议。

HTTPS：HTTPS 协议
fields.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The listener configurations of the egress proxy gateway instance.

Listeners in the same gateway instance cannot use the same port
parameters.help_zh:
出口代理网关实例的监听配置列表。

同一网关实例内不允许出现端口重复的监听
parameters.name: listener_properties

fields.help_en:
The ID of the private CA certificate.

This parameter is required when TlsInterceptMode is set to enable.
Do not specify this parameter when TlsInterceptMode is set to disable
fields.help_zh:
私有 CA 证书的 ID。

当 TlsInterceptMode 取值为 enable 时，该参数必填；
当 TlsInterceptMode 取值为 disable 时，请勿指定该参数
fields.name: private_ca_certificate_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable TLS interception. Valid values:

enable: enables TLS interception.

disable: disables TLS interception
fields.help_zh:
是否开启 TLS 拦截。取值：

enable：开启 TLS 拦截。

disable：关闭 TLS 拦截
fields.name: tls_intercept_mode

parameters.help_en: The TLS interception configuration of the egress proxy gateway instance
parameters.help_zh: 出口代理网关实例的 TLS 拦截配置
parameters.name: tls_intercept_properties

fields.help_en: The tag key. The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The value can be up to 256 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:

true: prechecks the request without creating the egress proxy gateway instance. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format, and service limits. If the request fails the precheck, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the precheck, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.

false (default): sends the request. If the request passes the precheck, the HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建出口代理网关实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回 HTTP 2xx 状态码并直接执行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

Note If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the client token. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端 Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符。

说明 若您未指定，则系统自动使用 API 请求的 RequestId 作为 ClientToken 标识。每次 API 请求的 RequestId 不一样
parameters.name: client_token

EgressProxyGatewayId.description_en: The ID of the egress proxy gateway instance
EgressProxyGatewayId.description_zh: 出口代理网关实例的 ID
